Pages on your site are returning an error

critical
The problem

Returned HTTP 404. This is happening on 2 pages.

Why it matters

Anyone landing there hits a dead end, and any ranking that page had is lost.

How to fix it

Restore the page or redirect it to the closest live page.

Only you can see these buttons. They disappear in the PDF and in the clean file.

Your website is not secure

critical
The problem

The site resolves over HTTP; no valid HTTPS response was found.

Why it matters

Browsers show a 'Not secure' warning next to your address. Most people leave before reading a word.

How to fix it

Install an SSL certificate and force every page to load securely.

Only you can see these buttons. They disappear in the PDF and in the clean file.

A page is telling Google to ignore it completely

critical
The problem

Page carries a noindex directive.

Why it matters

However good that page is, it cannot appear in search at all while this tag is on it.

How to fix it

Remove the noindex instruction from that page.

Only you can see these buttons. They disappear in the PDF and in the clean file.

The words customers search for barely appear on the page

high
The problem

'outstation cab delhi' appears 0x in body copy; missing from: meta_description, h2_h3, url_slug, image_alt, internal_anchors. This is happening on 7 pages.

Why it matters

Google matches searches to the words on your page. If the phrase is not there, you are not in the race.

How to fix it

Work the main keyword naturally into the intro, one sub-heading and the body.

Your business details are not machine-readable

high
The problem

No JSON-LD or microdata found on this page. This is happening on 7 pages.

Why it matters

Without this hidden data, Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT cannot confirm who you are, where you are, or what you charge — so they recommend someone else.

How to fix it

Add structured business data (name, address, phone, services) to the site.

high

Your images are invisible to Google

high
The problem

1 of 1 images have no alt text. This is happening on 3 pages.

Why it matters

Every image without a description is a missed entry in Google Images, and it fails accessibility checks that Google now watches.

How to fix it

Add a short description to each image saying what it shows.
